review_role: Independent grader and resource reviewer; no fitting, artifact generation, or target grading.

decision.quality_status: No scientific fit outputs or quality results exist; this is a resource decision only.
decision.authority: Root retains immutable recipe status and admission authority. This review does not mutate recipe.json or admit fits.

profile_observation.sample: 16 selected fitting sequences and 8 evaluation sequences per fold; 12 disposable heads, three epochs each.
profile_observation.interpretation: The profile used the producer's eight-sequence parent-inference batch path and measured its one-time warmup. It did not execute scientific heads or grade targets.

notes: Cache traffic is a transparent conservative pass-count reconstruction from the frozen source flow; it is not a measured 597 GB run.
The 31.861 GB cache payloads and repeated cache scans are not fully represented by the 24-sequence timing sample.
Source Parquet reads, candidate/parent output hashing, metadata and small artifact reads add I/O beyond the enumerated sequence-cache passes.

reserve_basis.full_scale_io_seconds: 1500 s covers the estimated 597.056 GB of repeated sequence-cache reads at an assumed 500 MB/s (approximately 398 MB/s required), leaving additional room for source reads, artifact hashes, writes, and small-file/metadata work. The assumption is deliberately below the probe's observed 1703.819 MiB/s minimum; the probe does not establish cold full-cache throughput.
reserve_basis.grading_seconds: 600 s is reserved for validating and scoring all 14 endpoints, 26 fold-local contrasts, component bootstrap intervals, outputs, and provenance. A historical six-fit panel grade took 60.611 s; scaling is workload-different, so the tenfold reserve is explicit rather than treated as a measurement.
reserve_basis.thermal_margin_seconds: 20% of the scaled profile projection is reserved for throughput variation and thermal throttling. The postboot profile itself had no thermal pauses; this margin is a planning reserve, not an observed loss rate.
reserve_basis.engineering_allowance_seconds: The 120 s allowance is retained for already identified bounded fixture, validation, and handoff overhead. The four-pass probe and six grader-contract tests remained under five seconds combined and fit within this allowance.

disk_capacity.base_payload_description: 31.861 GB sequence caches + 148 MB parent evaluation predictions + 888 MB candidate predictions.
disk_capacity.risk: Payload capacity is adequate by the recorded free-space snapshot; metadata pressure remains a live operational constraint and must be rechecked during writes.

pre_fit_contract_review.finding: The shared execution contract had a blocking status-name mismatch: the runner requires recipe status admitted_for_execution, while the grader previously accepted only admitted/completed.
pre_fit_contract_review.repair: The grader now accepts admitted_for_execution while retaining admitted and completed compatibility; a focused test uses the full frozen recipe, asserts 12-fit panel status, and points the target-cache path at a nonexistent file to demonstrate recipe validation does not open it.
pre_fit_contract_review.producer_consumer_source_audit: Reviewed delivery write_candidate against candidate, provenance, parent-cache, and panel validators. Candidate NPY/sidecar fields, provenance hash timing, parent evaluation-prediction JSON hash, source/cache identities, exact group ordering, and explicit in_sample_fit versus feature_only_eval scopes align by source inspection. No other mismatch was found.
pre_fit_contract_review.evidence_limit: This is a source audit plus a synthetic status test. No candidate or parent output artifacts existed, so it is not a runtime producer-to-grader handshake.

warm_panel_cost_gate.decision_basis: The observed single-fit wall is thermally confounded and is not a sustained-safe profile. Even one such fit plus three measured exports consumes 14,848.523 s before two more fits, grade, or engineering. Do not truncate the complete panel or borrow the 12-hour production reserve; defer all three remaining fits intact until a complete safe cost profile supports them.

verification.ruff: format and check passed under scripts/limited at 25% CPU and 700 MB.
